map.对企业品牌声誉进行系统化评估，涵盖品牌认知、公众信任、危机韧性、利益相关方关系、: A systematic assessment of corporate brand reputation covering five dimensions - brand awareness, public trust, crisis resilience, stakeholder relations and online reputation - to help formulate reputation improvement strategies.
map.📖 查看「声誉（管理/评估/提升）策略 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Reputation (Management/Assessment/Improvement) Strategy'
map.品牌声誉综合评分 = 品牌认知 + 公众信任 + 危机韧性 + 利益相关方关系: Brand reputation composite score = brand awareness + public trust + crisis resilience + stakeholder relations + online reputation (0 to 5 points each, 25 in total); 21 or above is outstanding reputation, 17 to 20 is good, 12 to 16 is average, and below 12 is reputation risk requiring an immediate repair plan.
map.声誉评估应定期进行(建议每季度一次): Reputation assessment should be carried out regularly (quarterly is recommended)
map.在线声誉可通过搜索关键词和社交媒体舆情监测: Online reputation can be monitored through search keywords and social media public opinion
map.单项低于3分的维度需重点改进: Dimensions scoring below 3 need focused improvement
map.危机韧性是声誉管理的核心防线: Crisis resilience is the core defence line of reputation management
map.季度品牌健康度盘点时，按品牌认知、公众信任、危机韧性、利益相关方、在线声誉 5: In the quarterly brand health review, score 0-5 on each of the five items - brand awareness, public trust, crisis resilience, stakeholders and online reputation - to quantify the reputation level.
map.危机事件前后各评一次，看危机韧性项是否骤降，评估声誉修复进度。: Assess once before and once after a crisis to see whether the crisis resilience score drops sharply and to evaluate the progress of reputation repair.
map.自动标红 ≤2 分的薄弱维度，作为下季度声誉提升的优先投入方向。: Weak dimensions scoring ≤2 are automatically flagged in red as the priority investment direction for the next quarter's reputation improvement.
map.5 个维度各 0~5 分：①品牌认知 ②公众信任 ③危机韧性 ④利益相关方（员工: 5 dimensions, 0-5 points each: ① brand awareness ② public trust ③ crisis resilience ④ stakeholders (employees/regulators/community) ⑤ online reputation; total = the sum of the five, 25 in total. Grades: ≥21 outstanding reputation, ≥17 good, ≥12 average, <12 reputation risk. Any dimension scoring ≤2 is listed as a 'dimension needing improvement'.
map.某成熟品牌：认知5+信任5+韧性4+相关方5+在线4 = 23 分，判声誉卓越，: A mature brand scores awareness 5 + trust 5 + resilience 4 + stakeholders 5 + online 4 = 23 points, judged outstanding reputation with no weak dimensions. By contrast, a brand that just went through a quality complaint scores awareness 2 + trust 1 + resilience 2 + stakeholders 1 + online 1 = 7 points, judged reputation risk, with all five dimensions - brand awareness, public trust, crisis resilience, stakeholders and online reputation - flagged as needing improvement. This shows it is not a single-point problem but a systemic trust collapse, requiring an overall reputation repair rather than a local patch.
map.声誉分低一定能救回来吗？: Can a low reputation score always be recovered?
map.取决于根因。若低分源于可被验证的事实问题（如质量、合规），修复前提是先把事实问题: It depends on the root cause. If the low score comes from verifiable factual problems (quality, compliance), the precondition for repair is to close the loop on the facts first; a reputation tool is only a 'water level gauge', not a 'repair agent'. If the low score comes from misunderstanding or information gaps, it can recover fairly quickly through transparent communication. The weak dimensions flagged by this tool help you locate the priority.
map.在线声誉和品牌认知有什么区别？: What is the difference between online reputation and brand awareness?
map.品牌认知衡量「有多少人知道你、知道什么」，在线声誉衡量「网络声量里的情感与口碑」: Brand awareness measures 'how many people know you and what they know', while online reputation measures 'the sentiment and word of mouth in the online voice'. A brand may have high awareness (everyone knows it) but poor online reputation (search results are all negative). When both are low it is most dangerous, because negative sentiment spreads quickly under high awareness.
map.品牌声誉评估工具从品牌认知、公众信任、危机韧性、利益相关方关系和在线声誉5个维度: The brand reputation assessment tool evaluates a company's reputation across five dimensions - brand awareness, public trust, crisis resilience, stakeholder relations and online reputation - helping identify reputation risk and formulate improvement strategies.
